messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: mydiff25p vs AssociationWithTSS files
parts: only important thing is the target.row column which should indicate the row number in mydiff25p, you see those other numbers because you are probably writing out the result file with row.names=TRUE and looking at the table in excel. the row number indicates which CpG in mydiff25p is the closest to the indicated TSS in the second table you attached.
